title: fix: avoid rebuilding pages when opening retired Settings links
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Opening `/settings` or a relocated Settings section briefly rebuilt the outgoing page before replacing it. Heavy outgoing pages such as LobsterDex paid to recreate content that immediately retired.

## User Impact

Settings links keep the outgoing page mounted until the real destination is ready. Destinations, query/hash handling, browser history, native Settings, and native navigation interception retain their existing behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

Apply the existing Settings redirect policy at the application's pre-match canonicalization boundary. The raw router loaders retain the same fallback policy. No cache, scheduling state, production diagnostics, dependency, or lazy boundary is added.

## Evidence

Acceptance recorded before timing: at least 5% target-flow improvement in 20 rotated base/head/A-A pairs per Chromium, WebKit, and Firefox; no affected flow beyond the timing band. Measure LobsterDex → `/settings` and relocated Channels/Plugins links using production bundles and the committed engines harness. Use browser-local application readiness, especially for WebKit; report Chromium task/script CPU separately. Observers/profiles run separately from timings. Baseline `aa9531e37637d977792513c3082d575916bd4325` and candidate run on the same Mac, with host load recorded. No size ceiling increase.

| Proof | Result |
|---|---|
| Router/outlet regression | 13 new redirect cases fail on the pinned base; existing model-setup case passes. Candidate: outgoing owner mounts once, stays mounted while destination is pending, disposes once on retirement. |
| Focused UI tests | 52/52 pass across the three changed test files. |
| URL and native behavior | Bookmark/history, query/hash, all ten raw-loader redirects, native embed and interception covered. |
| UI types; focused lint/format; production Knip | Passed. |
| Final comparative bytes | Startup 90,890 B gzip / one CSS request, unchanged. Chat 1,294,705 → 1,294,766 B; New Session 802,982 → 803,043 B (both +61 B, within the 64 B build variance). No caps raised. |
| Three-engine timing | All nine cells pass: 20 rotated base/head/A-A triplets per engine, plus ten additional Firefox Plugins triplets retaining the original outlier. Primary Settings paired improvement: Chromium 12.07%, WebKit 8.32%, Firefox 10.68%. |
| All route sources to `/settings` | 110/110 transitions pass (55 non-self sources × base/head). Outgoing LobsterDex 1,821 and Portals 126-element rebuilds removed; remaining generic leaf replacements are recorded separately. |
| Moved sections and native history | 40/40 heavy-page transitions across all ten moved URLs; 24/24 Back/Forward checks across three engines. An initial harness wait selected the wrong synthetic transcript on both builds; corrected to wait for the active default Chat composer. |
| Fresh Chromium profile | Baseline contains `LobsterdexPage`, `LobsterdexView` and `LobsterSvg` stacks; none appear on head. Separate sampled active time 308.33 → 276.98 ms; diagnostic only. |
| Full PR CI | Initial run `42393201988` found a missing test-line allocation (fixed with a 159-line owned allocation) and two cached-Chat reload timeouts. A fresh production build of that CI checkout's pristine main parent `99f4ff69c621` reproduces both exact names at line 408. Final head `aa94cec5f1e` ran `ci:full`: run `42394765007` completed with 42 successful jobs, 24 skipped, and only those two inherited E2E cases plus their aggregate gate failing. No cancellations. Native inherited-failure recovery applies; no failed case is claimed green. |

The inherited cases are `Details module loading > reads Outputs after startup settles and releases hidden demand (history error=false)` and `(history error=true)`. CI tested merge `9c4100b1abc0` has parents `99f4ff69c621` and `0f082f71a9d`. Main already includes #194639, which makes cached Chat wait for the Details module; these tests hold that module and wait for the transcript before releasing it. Both fail identically on pristine main (2/2, line 408), while both pass on the original benchmark baseline and candidate bundles that precede that main change. The final CI checkout `5eea0beeff41` has ordered parents `4d67ec34f597` and `aa94cec5f1e`; its reconstructed merge tree matches. The test and all three involved Chat owner/loader files have identical blobs on that main parent, its CI merge, and the reproduced main `99f4ff69c621`. No failed test is claimed green.

Production LOC 636 → 650; tests 384 → 543; existing harness 190 → 221. All ten Solid refactor-checklist categories remain unchanged; no reactive lifecycle machinery is added. The increase is shared pre-match policy and regression/history coverage.

## Timing detail

|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| lobsterdex → `/settings` | chromium | 20 | 236.20/208.10 | -12.07% | -0.84% | 247.52/213.88 | 273.07/244.66 |
| lobsterdex → `/settings/communications?section=channels` | chromium | 20 | 80.95/64.45 | -20.15% | -0.60% | 160.54/67.09 | 97.27/60.05 |
| lobsterdex → `/settings/automation?section=plugins` | chromium | 20 | 80.50/79.00 | -7.48% | +0.75% | 113.31/84.10 | 80.92/76.06 |
| lobsterdex → `/settings` | webkit | 20 | 396.50/364.00 | -8.32% | -0.63% | 426.60/384.00 | — |
| lobsterdex → `/settings/communications?section=channels` | webkit | 20 | 185.50/150.00 | -18.80% | -2.45% | 199.25/162.70 | — |
| lobsterdex → `/settings/automation?section=plugins` | webkit | 20 | 152.00/141.00 | -9.22% | +0.30% | 176.45/157.95 | — |
| lobsterdex → `/settings` | firefox | 20 | 281.00/241.00 | -10.68% | +0.55% | 347.40/283.65 | — |
| lobsterdex → `/settings/communications?section=channels` | firefox | 20 | 139.50/91.00 | -36.12% | +2.06% | 170.20/118.15 | — |

Application elapsed time is measured inside the page, not as the driver round trip. Chromium primary Settings task CPU is 273.07 → 244.66 ms (paired−9.60%, A/A−0.42%); task p95 288.42→254.07ms. Script median 128.18 → 123.64 ms. Host load 12.30–22.23 during the initial matrix. The Firefox Plugins n=20 run contained a 626 ms head outlier; all originals are retained in n=30, whose p95 is 164.10 → 132.95 ms. No observational instrumentation runs in timing captures. Synthetic Gateway fixtures measure renderer/router cost, not live provider latency.

Identical final Chat presentation after Portals→`/settings`; synthetic fixture only. The change removes a transient outgoing-page rebuild.
